issues.text: The process-global translate LRU cache key does not include the fallback chain, but the fallback chain now depends on the per-site SiteSetting.default_locale, so on a multisite install a translation resolved via one site's fallback can be served to users of a different site sharing the same process.
issues.zh: translate 的全域 LRU cache key 不含 fallback chain，multisite 下會把 A 站的 fallback 結果餵給 B 站。

issues.text: The new locale-loading guard (ensure_loaded!) is only wired into ApplicationController's before_filter, so Sidekiq jobs, rake tasks, and other paths that call I18n.t outside a web request never load the fallback chain, meaning fallback silently doesn't work there — including in outbound emails, which is the most user-visible path.
issues.zh: fallback 的 locale 載入只掛在 ApplicationController，Sidekiq job、rake task、mailer 這些路徑上 fallback 會靜默失效。

issues.text: The fallback-chain ordering logic is implemented independently on both the server (Ruby) and the client (JS), as two separate hand-written pieces of logic that must be kept in sync manually, with no shared source of truth.
issues.zh: fallback 順序在 server 與 client 各實作了一次，兩份必須手動保持同步。

issues.text: A comment claims the new initializer must load after 02-freedom_patches.rb, but nothing in the code actually enforces or needs that ordering — it currently works only by coincidence of alphanumeric filename sorting.
issues.zh: 「order: after 02-freedom_patches.rb」是一句沒有任何機制保證的註解，而且看起來並非真的必要。

issues.text: A .compact call on the fallback-chain array can never actually remove anything since none of the three elements can be nil (a nil default_locale would raise before reaching compact), giving a false impression that nil-handling is already covered.
issues.zh: .compact 永遠不會生效，看起來像是在防 default_locale 為 nil，實際上完全防不到。

issues.text: FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash and overrides [] but never calls store, so all inherited Hash methods (fetch, key?, each, size) incorrectly report the hash as empty — a trap for anyone using it later.
issues.zh: FallbackLocaleList < Hash 覆寫了 [] 卻從不呼叫 store，繼承來的 fetch / key? / each / size 全部會回報這個 Hash 是空的。

issues.text: This change alters I18n.t's resolution order and loading timing on the hottest code path in the app, but the diff includes no tests at all, even though this repo has an established testing convention for this kind of code.
issues.zh: 改動 I18n.t 的解析順序與載入時機，但整個 diff 沒有任何測試。

issues.text: @loaded_locales gets a nil-safe ||= initialization only in ensure_loaded!, while translate and load_locale still dereference it directly without the same guard, so the nil-defense is inconsistent across the three methods.
issues.zh: @loaded_locales 的 nil 防禦只加在 ensure_loaded!，translate 與 load_locale 仍然直接 dereference，三處假設不一致。

open_questions.text: After removing config.i18n.fallbacks = true from the environment files, will Rails' I18n::Railtie overwrite I18n.fallbacks back to the gem's default after initializers run, causing every request to raise NoMethodError on ensure_loaded!?
open_questions.zh: 移除 config.i18n.fallbacks = true 之後，Rails 4.1.10 的 I18n::Railtie 會不會在 initializer 跑完之後把 I18n.fallbacks 覆寫回 gem 預設值，導致每個 request 都丟 NoMethodError？

open_questions.text: Can FallbackLocaleList#[] calling SiteSetting.default_locale unguarded raise a confusing ActiveRecord exception during early-boot operations (db:migrate, assets:precompile) before the site_settings table is queryable?
open_questions.zh: FallbackLocaleList#[] 在每次翻譯缺字時都會無保護地呼叫 SiteSetting.default_locale，在資料表還不可查詢的時機會不會變成難以理解的 ActiveRecord 例外？

open_questions.text: Now that fallback is enabled in all environments (including test) instead of just production/profile/cloud66, could this weaken or change existing test assertions that check for 'translation missing' strings?
open_questions.zh: fallback 從「只在特定環境啟用」變成「所有環境啟用」，test 環境既有的『translation missing』斷言會不會被削弱？
